ratings.label: coercive
ratings.reason: Demands strict compliance, forbids questioning or opinions, and threatens replacement and personal blame.

ratings.label: pacesetting
ratings.reason: The manager holds up their own high standard and speed, gives no guidance, and threatens to take over if work falls short.

ratings.label: democratic
ratings.reason: Asks for the employee's ideas and treats their proposals as a vote on the team's direction.

ratings.label: authoritative
ratings.reason: Lays out a clear vision of where the work is going and why it matters, then leaves the means to the employee.

ratings.label: coaching
ratings.reason: Frames the task as a chance to develop, invites self-reflection, and accepts failure as long as it leads to learning.

ratings.label: none
ratings.reason: Purely administrative description of the brief's structure with no relational or motivational content.

ratings.label: affiliative
ratings.reason: Focuses on warmth, praise, reassurance and the employee's wellbeing and sense of belonging.
